text: Alliance Leadership Ambassadors Ambassadors CHERI Alliance Ambassadors help explain CHERI, create resources, support events, and introduce new communities to the ecosystem.. CHERI adoption grows when trusted community members can explain the technology in ways that resonate with developers, researchers, industry professionals, educators, and policymakers. The Ambassador Programme supports people who want to help make those connections. What ambassadors do Ambassadors choose activities that match their interests, skills, and availability. These may include: writing tutorials, articles, demonstrations, or technical papers giving talks and creating video or presentation material sharing accurate news and practical experience helping with conferences, workshops, and online events introducing organisations and communities to the Alliance Mentoring newcomers and supporting community projects Providing feedback on educational materials and outreach activities Ambassadors act in accordance with Alliance policies and programme guidance. The role does not make an ambassador a governing-board member, product certifier, or official spokesperson for the entire Alliance. What the programme offers The programme provides opportunities to: Connect with the global CHERI community Participate in working groups and technical discussions Access community resources, events, and briefings Contribute to projects and outreach activities Gain recognition for community contributions Help shape the future of the CHERI ecosystem Specific benefits and participation requirements may evolve as the programme develops. Joining the programme The programme is open to people with a genuine interest in CHERI, cybersecurity, and community engagement. Applicants should be active within a relevant technical, research, industry, education, or regional community and interested in helping others learn about CHERI. Participation begins with an application and review process, followed by onboarding for successful applicants. Apply or request more information through the Alliance contact page.
